   350: 
   351: function createDateStamp() {
   352:   const now = new Date();
   353: 
   354:   const year = now.getFullYear();
   355: 
   356:   const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
   357: 
   358:   const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
   359: 
   360:   return `${year}${month}${day}`;

    67: export function preloadGlobalSearchIndex():
    68:   Promise<CompactSearchItem[]> {
    69:   if (cachedSearchItems) {
    70:     return Promise.resolve(cachedSearchItems);
    71:   }
    72: 
    73:   if (searchItemsPromise) {
    74:     return searchItemsPromise;
    75:   }
    76: 
    77:   searchItemsPromise = fetch(SEARCH_INDEX_URL, {
    78:     cache: "force-cache",
    79:   })
    80:     .then((response) => {
    81:       if (!response.ok) {
    82:         throw new Error(
    83:           `全站搜索索引加载失败：${response.status}`
    84:         );
    85:       }
    86: 
    87:       return response.json() as Promise<CompactSearchItem[]>;
    88:     })
    89:     .then((items) => {
    90:       cachedSearchItems = items;
    91:       return items;
    92:     })
    93:     .catch((error) => {
    94:       searchItemsPromise = null;
    95:       throw error;
    96:     });
    97: 
    98:   return searchItemsPromise;
    99: }

   102:   "products",
   103:   "compatible-models",
